title: AND-Controlled Relay Snubber Interface
description: MOSFET is not generated; AND output exposes gate-control net GT and the relay/snubber passives are shown as accepted R/L/C records. Requested 100mH/100n are normalized to donor-safe 5mH/1uF visible text.
hidden_supply_policy: Pin 14 and pin 7 are user-input-only metadata for 74HCxx gates; no explicit IC supply pins are emitted.
terminal_policy: IC signal pins use $TERINPUT/$TEROUTPUT. R/C/L endpoints use $TERBIDIR. Passive G0 uses same-name $TERBIDIR; an IC pin tied to ground would use a same-name $TERINPUT(G0), not a bidirectional IC terminal.
layout_policy: Compact last-two V2: IC package spacing is 3,810,000 and nearby passive columns start at x=8,890,000.

normalizations.hidden_supply: Ignore user pin 14/VCC/+5V and pin 7/GND/0V for every 74HCxx package.
normalizations.terminal_policy: IC signal pins use $TERINPUT/$TEROUTPUT. R/C/L endpoints use $TERBIDIR. Passive G0 uses same-name $TERBIDIR; an IC pin tied to ground would use a same-name $TERINPUT(G0), not a bidirectional IC terminal.
normalizations.layout_policy: Compact last-two V2: IC package spacing is 3,810,000 and nearby passive columns start at x=8,890,000.
